basics.name: Fadlan Kautsar Noer
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: No failure, no growth. Take your shot, even if your target is the moon. And if you fail along the way, you may still discover the beauty of the stars.

work.summary: Responsible for building and evolving digital products across the agency ecosystem by combining software engineering best practices with modern AI technologies. Lead the development of internal tools.
highlights: Combine software engineering best practices with modern AI technologies to ship digital products.
Lead the development of internal tools used across the agency ecosystem.

work.summary: Deliver high-impact freelance projects for Indonesian clients: custom web platforms and digital marketing solutions.
highlights: Binary Tree Digital Business: built a genealogy and commission engine for a global network marketing company, classifying every node as Profit Branch or Power Branch and automatically cascading bonuses up the upline.

Crypto Custodian: served as Lead Engineer for a licensed Indonesian crypto exchange custody platform, re-architecting the settlement hot-path as Go microservices to achieve 5,000+ RPS with p99 under 100ms.
Managed Google Ads campaigns and built more than 10 company profiles for various clients.

work.summary: Delivered and maintained digital products on a PaaS platform serving Indonesian industry stakeholders, then led the engineering team across web and mobile product lines.
highlights: Built and maintained products on the PaaS platform serving Indonesia industry stakeholders.
Delivered 10+ projects spanning web and mobile applications across the company product lines.
Led technical maintenance for a digital bank mobile app, coordinating hotfixes and feature releases.
Led and coordinated the engineering team, assigning responsibilities across deliveries.
Developed, oversaw, and maintained technological applications and systems.

work.summary: Since 1967, PT Dwidaya Worldwide has been trusted as one of the biggest travel agencies in Indonesia, with annual achievements including Top Agent from major airlines (Singapore Airlines, Cathay Pacific, Qatar Airways, KLM, Garuda Indonesia, Eva Air, Lufthansa, and more).
highlights: Ticketing with Travelport Galileo, Amadeus, and Sabre.
Fulfilling customer needs and exceeding expectations through tailored services.
Planning customer trips (flights, hotels, land packages, travel documents, and more).
Tour leading and guiding on guided tours.
Resolving internal and external operational problems.

courses: Learning Web Development using React JS
Learning Mobile App Development using React Native
Create REST API using Node JS & Express JS
Build 2 Web Applications and 1 Mobile App

projects.name: Laundry Landing Page
projects.description: Landing page for a laundry service business (https://laundry.fadlank.web.id/): showcasing services, pricing, and contact with smooth animations.
highlights: Built a compelling landing page with smooth scroll animations using GSAP to showcase laundry services and drive customer inquiries.
Implemented responsive layouts and interactive pricing tables for different service tiers.
Stack: SvelteKit, Svelte 5, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP, Lucide Icons, Cloudflare.

projects.name: Prompt Builder
projects.description: Structured prompt builders for GPT Image 2 and Seedance 2.0 (https://prompt-builder.fadlank.web.id/): fill the fields, then copy the result as a polished prompt.
highlights: Users struggled with prompt syntax across AI image models: built structured web forms with real-time preview and one-click copy, reducing prompt crafting time.
Supporting GPT Image 2 and Seedance 2.0 with field categories, syntax hints, and copy-to-clipboard for fast workflow.
Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Cloudflare Workers.
